author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
Is this codable?
Maximum 13 Players. 
There are 13 players who play this game. Player spawn on a platform with 13 rooms infront of them all openable with a pressure plate below 2 iron doors, one the way in, the other the way out.
There are 13 Rooms which player must enter within 15 seconds. If they do not, the platform will disintegrate and turn into lava.
However out of those 13 rooms, one of them are trapped and the player will die a horrible death. (He falls into the pit of death.) (Or he/she could fall into a lava pit if it's too tedious to build.)
Once one player has been eliminated, the 13 doors leading the way out will open, leading to another platform. However instead of 13 rooms and there are only 12 rooms. Once again, the moment the door opens a 15 second timer will be initiated. And then the process continues so on and on until there is one final winner standing.

replies.author: Phobiaxx
replies.body:
@spicy
@cez
hmmm... I have an idea...
since its called string of existence...
there are 16 players,
and 17 main rooms, and 16 spawn rooms
14 players are survivors... who need to escape from the labyrinth of death, but only 1 will make it, and they are chased by two Death Mages...
The survivors have nothing.
The death mages have black leather armor... and a golden sword, with sharpness -2 and... resistance 3, that disappear when the rooms lock.
Gameplay...
the 14 survivors have 3 seconds head start to run into the collection of rooms. then, the death-mages are released... and they spawn in the center room of the labyrinth, and chase after the survivors.
the chase will last for 10 seconds... then it will announce.. THE GATES ARE CLOSING!
anyone in a doorway will be killed. Survivors must go to the center of the room, where there will be a 1-block deep depression and if they step into it... they are invulnerable to anything(resistance 5)
Gate Closing:
When the gate closes-all effects are lost, and it will announce: "The Gates are closed...your DOOM will arrive!"
There are 5 different deaths:
fire
a drop into lava
falling flaming wither skeletons
a drop into the void
a drop into a pit of blazes
deathmages can be killed too, tho they have 2 lives, while everyone else only has 1
deathmages cannot hurt one another, players can hurt one another
after 2 deaths, 1 room will be filled with sand. and so on
Awards:
last one standing gets 20XP
2nd last standing gets 15
3rd=10
4th=5
5th=4
6th=3
7th=2
deathmages get 2XP for each kill
just an idea :)
